title: TIG's latest single, "What I'm On," is a high-energy banger
htmlContent:
TIG, the up-and-coming rapper from Atlanta, has just dropped his latest single, "What I'm On," and it's already making waves in the hip-hop scene. The track is a dynamic blend of hard-hitting beats and powerful lyrics that showcase TIG's raw talent and unapologetic style.

"What I'm On" is a track that captures the essence of TIG's unique approach to rap music. The lyrics are unfiltered and honest, detailing the highs and lows of his life in the streets of Atlanta. The chorus is catchy and memorable, with TIG repeating the line "Don't know the kind of shit I'm on" repeatedly, creating an infectious energy that's impossible to resist.

The song "What I'm On" is a solid addition to TIG's growing discography and a must-listen for anyone who loves gritty, unapologetic rap music. With its infectious beat and powerful lyrics, this track will become a fan favorite and solidify TIG's position as one of hip-hop's most exciting new voices.
